fact: Nichan reports that the health ministry's international open tender for a national smart health system able to manage 50 million patient files, estimated at 189,999,000 dirhams with bids to be opened on 12 September 2024, itself records that no shared national patient register exists; the article names no funding source and its text carries no date, so the date given with the lead is used.
title: 19 مليارا لإقامة نظام تدبير ملفات 50 مليون مريض بالمغرب
